vuln_statements.explanation: This statement at line 2738 calls tk_update_leap_state_all() which internally hardcodes a reference to the global tk_core structure instead of using the provided tkd argument. During NTP adjustments in auxiliary timekeeping contexts, this causes incorrect modifications to the core timekeeper rather than the intended auxiliary timekeeper, leading to sequence lock violations.
